description: DiscoverWater is a public dashboard that brings together key performance information for the water and sewerage companies of England and Wales, agreed by the companies, the water regulators, the UK and Welsh Governments and the Consumer Council for Water. Charts compare companies on drinking water quality, leakage (per kilometre of main and per property, against each company's target and a 2019-20 baseline, with the length of mains), loss of supply, water pressure, consumption, treatment and supply, environmental performance such as river and bathing water protection and emissions, customer experience ratings and average bills. The site was updated in January 2026 with 2024-25 performance data and 2026-27 bills, and the next update with 2025-26 data is due in late 2026. It is free to view in English and Welsh, but no download, API or licence was found. Caveats: values are company-level annual figures only, sources are the companies and Water UK, charts must be read from the web pages, and metric definitions follow regulatory reporting that changes between price control periods. Simulation uses: benchmarking and calibrating utility-level reliability, leakage and interruption rates in water supply resilience models, and relating network length to losses. Related records: the EPA public water system service areas (data-epa-public-water-system-service-areas) for a comparable US utility layer.
